activities.name: Local Sponsor Appearance
activities.description: Attend a small meet-and-greet event for a local sponsor. Good practice for bigger opportunities.
activities.flavor_text: Every journey starts somewhere. These small events build the foundation.
activities.success_body: {driver} attended a promotional event for {team}'s local partner, building grassroots support.

activities.name: Basic Media Day
activities.description: Standard press duties and team content creation. Essential for any racing driver.

risk.failure_narrative: An awkward interview moment makes the rounds on social media.

activities.flavor_text: The basics. Handle them well and doors will open.
activities.success_body: {driver} impressed in team content sessions, showing natural media presence.

activities.name: Sponsor Activation
activities.description: Official sponsor activation with meet-and-greets, photo ops, and fan engagement.

risk.failure_narrative: The sponsor expressed mild disappointment with the turnout.

activities.flavor_text: Sponsors invest in you. Show them it's paying off.
activities.success_body: {driver} delivered an engaging sponsor activation, strengthening commercial relationships.

activities.name: Fan Event
activities.description: Public fan event with autograph sessions and Q&A. Build your fanbase.
activities.flavor_text: The fans are your foundation. Connect with them.
activities.success_headline: {driver} connects with fans at public event
activities.success_body: Hundreds of fans turned out to meet {driver} at a public appearance event.

activities.name: Brand Photoshoot
activities.description: Professional photoshoot for team and sponsor marketing materials.
activities.flavor_text: Image matters. Look like a champion, become a champion.
activities.success_body: {driver} completed a professional photoshoot for upcoming marketing campaigns.

activities.name: Major Sponsor Campaign
activities.description: Featured role in a major sponsor's advertising campaign. High visibility.

risk.failure_narrative: The campaign didn't land as expected. Sponsors are questioning the investment.

activities.flavor_text: National exposure. The world starts to notice.
activities.success_body: {driver} has been unveiled as the face of a major sponsor campaign, raising their profile significantly.

activities.name: Global Media Feature
activities.description: In-depth interview and feature piece for international motorsport media.

risk.failure_narrative: A controversial quote is taken out of context, creating unwanted headlines.

activities.flavor_text: The international spotlight. Handle it with grace.
activities.success_body: An in-depth profile of {driver} has been published, highlighting their journey and ambitions.

activities.name: Premium Brand Event
activities.description: Exclusive event representing a premium brand. Network with VIPs and industry leaders.

risk.failure_narrative: The event didn't match expectations. Some industry contacts seemed unimpressed.

activities.flavor_text: Rub shoulders with the elite. Your network is your net worth.
activities.success_headline: {driver} represents premium brand at exclusive event
activities.success_body: {driver} attended an exclusive industry event, networking with key figures and raising their profile.

activities.name: Documentary Feature
activities.description: Be featured in a motorsport documentary. Share your story with the world.

risk.failure_narrative: The documentary portrayed you in an unflattering light. Managing expectations is key.

activities.flavor_text: Your story, told to millions. Make it compelling.
activities.success_body: A new documentary featuring {driver}'s journey through racing has captivated audiences worldwide.

activities.name: Global Ambassador Campaign
activities.description: Become a global brand ambassador. Multi-year partnership potential.

risk.failure_narrative: The ambassadorship hasn't delivered expected results. There's pressure to perform.

activities.flavor_text: Global recognition. You're not just a driver anymore—you're a brand.
activities.success_body: {driver} has signed a major deal as global ambassador for a leading brand, cementing their status as a marketable star.

activities.name: Signature Sponsor Partnership
activities.description: A signature sponsorship deal with your name attached. The pinnacle of commercial success.

risk.failure_narrative: The signature deal is under scrutiny. There's enormous pressure to justify the investment.

activities.flavor_text: A partnership that defines an era. Leave your mark.
activities.success_body: {driver} has secured a groundbreaking signature sponsorship deal, joining the ranks of motorsport's most marketable athletes.

activities.name: Charity Ambassador
activities.description: Represent a charitable cause. Good for reputation and personal fulfillment.
activities.flavor_text: Use your platform for good. It's more than racing.
activities.success_body: {driver} has taken on a role as charity ambassador, using their platform to raise awareness.

activities.name: Team Partner Showcase
activities.description: Featured appearance at a team partner's corporate event. Shows your value to the team.

risk.failure_narrative: The team partner expected more engagement. Some relationship repair needed.

activities.flavor_text: Show your team you bring value beyond the track.
activities.success_body: {driver} represented {team} at a major partner event, demonstrating strong commercial appeal.

activities.name: Academy Sponsor Showcase
activities.description: Represent your academy at a sponsor event. Strengthen your pathway to F1.
activities.flavor_text: The academy is watching. Every impression counts.
activities.success_body: {driver} showcased their potential at an academy sponsor event, reinforcing their F1 pathway credentials.
